2609.18009.title: G-Mamba: Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
2609.18009.paper_summary: Lightweight audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) models face a critical trade-off between computational efficiency and cross-modal alignment accuracy. While simple concatenation lacks relational expressiveness, dense cross-attention incurs computational overhead and is prone to unreliable cross-modal correspondence under strong acoustic interference. We propose Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba (SG-Mamba), a lightweight AVSE framework that integrates a sparse heterogeneous graph with a linear-complexity Mamba backbone. The graph explicitly models modality-specific relations through content-adaptive attention and cross-frame audio-visual connections, while Mamba captures long-range temporal context. We further introduce an audio skip connection to preserve spectral detail without sacrificing noise suppression. Evaluated on LRS3, SG-Mamba achieves competitive or superior performance against strong lightweight baselines and reaches 13.091 dB SI-SDR under noise-only condition. It also remains robust in cluttered multi-speaker conditions with a competitive cost of 3.45 G MACs (or 6.90 G FLOPs). Results on VoxCeleb2 further suggest that explicit structural priors improve robustness, generalizability, and computational efficiency in lightweight AVSE.
2609.18009.paper_summary_zh: 輕量級視聽語音增強（AVSE）模型面臨計算效率與跨模態對齊準確性之間的關鍵權衡。雖然簡單的串聯缺乏關係表達能力，但密集的交叉注意力會產生計算開銷，並且在強烈的聲學干擾下容易導致不可靠的跨模態對應。我們提出了稀疏圖引導的Mamba（SG-Mamba），這是一個輕量級的AVSE框架，將稀疏異質圖與線性複雜度的Mamba主幹整合在一起。該圖通過內容自適應注意力和跨幀視聽連接明確建模模態特定關係，而Mamba則捕捉長距離的時間上下文。我們進一步引入了一個音頻跳接連接，以在不犧牲噪聲抑制的情況下保留光譜細節。在LRS3上的評估中，SG-Mamba在噪聲僅條件下達到了13.091 dB SI-SDR，並且在強大的輕量級基準上表現出競爭力或優越的性能。它在雜亂的多說話者條件下也保持穩健，且競爭成本為3.45 G MACs（或6.90 G FLOPs）。在VoxCeleb2上的結果進一步表明，明確的結構先驗提高了輕量級AVSE的穩健性、可泛化性和計算效率。
